VERDICT goal: the gained commits bind each stored route result to the defining code's identity — reckon/route_results.py:123 rejects a record whose `source_revision` differs from the served snapshot, and reckon/route_results.py:397-400 carries that identity into the refresh child's argv; commit 749c46f13 makes the child store the argument exactly rather than falling back to its own (empty) snapshot.
VERDICT done_when: the done_when names tests/test_a_stored_result_is_served_by_the_code_that_derived_it.py; the manifest records that gate and I re-ran it against the landed source extracted at 89a2b365 (2 passed in 4.91s, EXIT=0) and reproduced both negative controls from that same source.
VERDICT write_paths: the manifest declares reckon/route_results.py, tests/test_a_stored_result_is_served_by_the_code_that_derived_it.py, docs/evidence/fragments/the-site-answers-fast-and-agrees/a-stored-route-result-is-served-only-by-the-code-that-derived-it.html and a docs/figures directory for the node; the gained diff 8959b8ac..89a2b365 changes the first two and the fragment, and writes nothing else.
VERDICT manifest: read at r-20261020T071534950992-a-stored-route-result-is-served-only-by-the-code-that-derived-it/manifest.md; it records the repair, names a repair checkpoint, and its figures reconcile with the logs on disk (baseline 2 failed EXIT=1 at 9b2645fd, after 0 failed EXIT=0 at 749c46f13, importing population 64 passed both arms).
VERDICT diff: read commit by commit against the previously reviewed head 8959b8ac — 2 commits, 2 files: 749c46f13 introduces the _SOURCE_REVISION_UNSET sentinel so an explicitly-absent child revision is stored as null instead of falling back, stops appending an empty --source-revision, and clears serve._SOURCE_SNAPSHOT inside the test's child context; 89a2b365e extends the evidence fragment with the isolated-child control.
CALL_SITES: reckon/serve.py:2912 _served_result(("rollup",)), reckon/serve.py:3225 _served_result(...), reckon/serve.py:3284 _served_result(("discover", project)), reckon/serve.py:3236 _start_refresh(key), reckon/serve.py:2781 velocity_result(key), reckon/serve.py:2624 _stored_discovery(...), reckon/change_streams.py:374-375 _start_refresh("discover"/"rollup"), reckon/route_results.py:_refresh_main (the `python -m reckon.route_results` child entry point)
SCORE goal_fidelity: 20
JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: reckon/route_results.py:123 makes a record from another revision read as absent and reckon/route_results.py:513 now stores the child's parsed argument verbatim, so each stored result carries exactly the identity of the code that asked for it.
SCORE evidence: 18
JUSTIFICATION evidence: every arm the done_when names is recorded in a log that ends in a bare EXIT= under the run directory, and I independently reproduced the read-side and child-argument controls; one caveat is that the 64-test importing figure that docs/evidence/fragments/the-site-answers-fast-and-agrees/a-stored-route-result-is-served-only-by-the-code-that-derived-it.html labels "repaired head" while review-importing.log's own header reads "working tree based on 8959b8ac".
SCORE scope_discipline: 20
JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: git diff 8959b8ac..89a2b365 touches only reckon/route_results.py, tests/test_a_stored_result_is_served_by_the_code_that_derived_it.py and the node's evidence fragment, all inside the declared write paths.
SCORE durability: 20
JUSTIFICATION durability: I extracted 89a2b365 to a scratch tree and reinstated each regression — dropping the comparison at reckon/route_results.py:123 reddens test_discovery_from_another_revision_is_a_miss (EXIT=1), treating a missing field as a match reddens it too, and removing the argv propagation at reckon/route_results.py:400 reddens test_refresh_child_stores_its_parents_revision (EXIT=1).
SCORE fit: 19
JUSTIFICATION fit: `_source_revision` follows the module's existing lazy-import idiom for serve globals at reckon/route_results.py:91 and adds no plan, sprint or ticket name; the only slip is the parameter annotation at reckon/route_results.py:134.
SCORE reuse: 20
JUSTIFICATION reuse: the sole owner of the served revision is the `revision` field on served_code.SourceSnapshot (reckon/served_code.py:74), which the new helper reads rather than re-derives; a search of reckon/ for an existing accessor of the current served revision found none (serve.py:2001 `_revision_matches` compares a URL's requested revision for cache headers, a different capability), and `_persisted_cache_path` is reused unchanged for the store path.
FINDING reckon/route_results.py:134 follow-on: the parameter annotation `str | object | None` collapses to `object`, so a reader cannot tell from the signature that only a string or the sentinel is meaningful; a named sentinel type would carry that contract.
